subject: Desktop app stuck syncing at 99%
body: Since yesterday the Tidewater desktop app on my Windows laptop sits at 99% and never finishes. The same three folders keep showing the spinning arrows. Restarting the app did not help.

subject: Login keeps sending me back to the sign-in page
body: When I sign in through our company single sign-on I land on Tidewater for a second and then get bounced back to the login screen, over and over. It started this morning for our whole office.

subject: Our webhook endpoint stopped receiving events
body: We have a webhook that posts file events to our internal system. Nothing has arrived since Tuesday afternoon. Our server is up and nothing changed on our side as far as I know, although our admin did tidy up some settings that day.

subject: CSV export never arrives
body: I request the full activity export for our workspace and get the 'we will email you' message, but no email ever comes. We have about 40,000 members. Smaller date ranges work.

subject: No notifications on my iPhone anymore
body: After I reinstalled the Tidewater app on my iPhone I stopped getting any push notifications for mentions. Notifications are allowed in the phone settings and they work on my iPad.

subject: Invitation emails are not reaching new colleagues
body: I have invited five new colleagues at our partner company twice. None of them received the invitation email, not even in spam. Invites to people in my own company arrive fine.

subject: Integration gets 'too many requests' errors since we upgraded
body: We moved to the Business plan last week because we needed higher API limits. Our nightly integration still fails with too many requests errors at the same point as before the upgrade.

subject: Calendar events show the wrong time for some teammates
body: Meetings in our shared team calendar appear one hour off for a few people on my team, while others see the right time. It is the same event, we compared screens.
note: Approved in March. Failed on later tickets with the same symptoms; evidence lowered by the team lead.

subject: Search cannot find documents we uploaded recently
body: Search returns nothing for files we uploaded in the last few days, even when I type the exact file name. Older files are found without a problem.
note: Approved in April. Failed on later tickets with the same symptoms; evidence lowered by the team lead.

subject: Two-factor codes are rejected as invalid
body: My authenticator app codes are refused with 'invalid code' when I log in. I typed them carefully and tried several fresh codes in a row.
note: Approved in May. Failed on later tickets with the same symptoms; evidence lowered by the team lead.

subject: Charged twice after changing plan
body: We switched from monthly to annual on the 3rd and our card was charged twice on the same day for what looks like the same seats.

subject: Invoice is missing our VAT number
body: Our accounting team rejected the latest invoice because our VAT number is not printed on it. We entered it during signup.
